SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-13: CQL — Date/Time Operators Part 1. Test these items: Add (left DateTime, right Quantity), After precision of, Before precision of, Date(year, month, day), DateTime(year, month, day, ...), Component From precision, Difference in precision between, Duration in precision between. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
